Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.widgets.builtin

Class WidgetCardSpec

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.widgets.builtin.WidgetCardSpec
public final class WidgetCardSpec extends Object
Immutable, Java 3D-free metadata describing a kind of widget card, plus a factory that creates instances of it.

This is the pure-Swing counterpart of WidgetDescriptor: the 2D desktop's gallery and widget layer list and build cards from these specs, and the 3D BuiltinWidgetProvider derives its own descriptors from the same specs so the metadata (id, name, category, icon, size) is written once.

    • WidgetCardSpec

      public WidgetCardSpec(String id, String displayName, String category, String iconResource, int defaultWidth, int defaultHeight, Supplier<WidgetCard> factory)
      Parameters:
      id - unique widget type id (e.g. "clock")
      displayName - human-readable name (e.g. "Clock")
      category - grouping label for the gallery (e.g. "System")
      iconResource - classpath resource for a gallery icon, or null
      defaultWidth - default card width in pixels
      defaultHeight - default card height in pixels
      factory - creates a fresh WidgetCard instance
